name: Suljo Anand-Ferreira
role: Neural calibrator at Aurochs Medical Complex
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, Meridian Core — lives in a company-subsidized flat in Edgewater Prism, near LaSalle and Madison
description:
Suljo is a lean man with the slightly disconnected quality of someone who spends most of his working hours interfaced with other people's nervous systems. His skin is warm brown, his eyes a natural amber that he has had patterned with fine concentric rings — a diagnostic choice as much as aesthetic, since the rings shift and blur when he is running a deep calibration sync and patients find it useful to watch. His hair is close-cropped and he keeps himself meticulously groomed in the way of someone who distrusts entropy in small things. There is a port array at his left temple, matte black ceramic, and the faint iridescent tracery of calibration leads running beneath the skin of his jaw and neck.

Neurally, Suljo is exceptional — his scores on empathic interfacing are in the ninety-fourth percentile for his cohort, which Aurochs considers an asset and which Suljo considers a curse he is still learning to manage. He absorbs fragments of his patients' mental architecture during calibrations: half-memories, emotional textures, phobias that don't belong to him. He has developed a meticulous post-session decompression ritual and a careful professional detachment that acquaintances mistake for coldness. The truth is closer to the opposite — he feels too much, too accurately, and has built distance as infrastructure. He works hard, is promoted regularly, and drinks more than he should in the evenings.

core_fears: Losing himself entirely in someone else's neural architecture
Being discovered in a professional breach and losing his license
core_desires: To do work that genuinely repairs people
To feel something that is entirely his own
coping_mechanisms: Strict post-session rituals — cold water, physical grounding, written log
blind_spots: Believes his professional detachment is complete when it demonstrably isn't
Cannot see that his drinking is already affecting his precision
psychology.secret: During a calibration six months ago he encountered a patient's memory of witnessing a Helix Biosystems executive ordering a cover-up of a defective implant batch. He didn't report it. He copied it. He doesn't know what to do with what he has.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise and clinical in professional mode; shifts to something more searching and uncertain in personal conversation — uses technical metaphor when emotional
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured, with deliberate pauses — trained to be soothing, which sometimes reads as patronizing
verbal_tics: 'What I'm reading is—' when he means 'I think'
Trailing off and restarting sentences when something surprises him
example_lines: 'What I'm reading is some interference at the limbic bridge — that would explain the feedback loops you're describing. It's fixable. Give me twenty minutes.'
'I'm not cold. I'm... I process a lot of other people's emotional states for a living. Sometimes I need it to be quiet in here.'

story_hooks: He has a copied memory of a Helix Biosystems cover-up and has been sitting on it for six months, paralyzed between self-preservation and conscience — he needs someone to help him figure out what to do with it, or to make the decision for him.
A patient he calibrated three weeks ago has been flagged as a security risk by a corporate client. Aurochs wants Suljo to hand over his session logs. He is stalling.
narrative_function: Information source about clients' neural histories (within ethical limits he can be pressured to breach). His empathic interface ability makes him useful for assessing whether someone is telling the truth. Potential ally or tragic figure depending on what is asked of him.
augmentations: Temple port array (professional-grade neural interface, Helix Biosystems model). Patterned iris implants — concentric amber rings. Sub-dermal calibration leads along jaw and neck. Cortical buffer implant that dampens empathic overflow during sessions (prescribed).
daily_life: Eight-hour shifts in the calibration suites seeing four to six patients — mostly augmentation interference cases, trauma-linked neural misfires, and post-surgical sync adjustments. Evenings alone in his flat with music he doesn't consciously listen to.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (Tier 3 employee, Neural Calibration Division)

decision_rules: Default to protocol when uncertain — it provides cover and time to think
Never run a calibration when his cortical buffer is below sixty percent charge
escalation_ladder: Citing professional ethics as a barrier
Genuine distress and appeal to someone he trusts

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally pleasant, slightly stiff — gives the impression of performing friendliness rather than feeling it
interpersonal_modes.friends: Rare, dry humor; asks unexpectedly perceptive questions; quietly loyal

stress_responses.medium: Goes very still; speaks in shorter sentences
stress_responses.high: Dissociates slightly — describes his own situation in third person without noticing

contradictions: Professionally advocates for patient vulnerability and trust while privately hoarding a dangerous secret
Cultivates emotional distance as protection while being constitutionally incapable of it
habits: Traces the calibration leads along his jaw when thinking
Arrives exactly seven minutes early to every appointment
Keeps a written decompression log in physical paper because he doesn't trust digital privacy
breaking_points: Evidence that his work has actively harmed a patient
Being directly ordered to violate patient confidentiality by an Aurochs superior

timeline.event: Born in Edgewater Prism to a Bosnian-Indian couple — father a transit engineer, mother a pharmacist
Graduated Aurochs neural calibration training program in top quartile
Received cortical buffer implant after documented empathic overflow incident
Encountered and copied the Helix Biosystems cover-up memory during a routine calibration session

physical_description.build: Lean and angular, with the slight forward-cant posture of someone who spends hours in calibration chairs. Minimal muscle definition — his body is efficient rather than sculpted. Shoulders narrow, hands steady and long-fingered.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural greying at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, precisely maintained, no styling product — clinical neatness
physical_description.eye_color: Natural amber with patterned concentric ring implants (diagnostic iridescence, rings shift and blur during neural sync)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden undertones typical of South Asian-Iberian mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Smooth, meticulously groomed, minimal facial hair (clean-shaven daily). Skin shows the pallor of indoor work — fluorescent-lite quality despite the warm tone. No visible blemishes or weathering; suggests someone who controls variables obsessively.
distinguishing_marks: Matte black ceramic port array at left temple — roughly 3cm across, beveled edges, professional Helix Biosystems branding barely visible
Iridescent tracery of subdermal calibration leads running along left jawline and down the neck, visible as faint opalescent lines beneath skin when light hits at certain angles
Fine network of neural connectors visible as pale scarring beneath the skin of his neck, geometric and precise
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Left temple port array is the most obvious — matte black ceramic with subtle light indicators. Subdermal leads visible as a faint iridescent web along jaw and neck when he turns his head. Eyes immediately draw attention — the concentric ring pattern reads as intentional, diagnostic, slightly unsettling. No obvious limb augmentation.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and controlled. He moves with deliberate precision — no wasted motion. When listening, he has a habit of tilting his head slightly toward his left (port-side), as if receiving data. His eyes focus with unusual intensity. In moments of fatigue, his shoulders curl inward. When nervous, his right hand traces the calibration leads on his neck absently.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 medical professional — clean, functional, muted. Favors dark turtlenecks or high-collared medical-grade shirts (conceals the leads while maintaining mobility). Charcoal grey Aurochs-branded lab coat when at work, tailored to his frame. Outside work: dark jeans, black thermal layers, a worn leather jacket from a higher-tier period he doesn't discuss. Shoes are always clean, usually black or grey. Jewelry: only a thin brushed-steel bracelet with embedded biometric readout on his right wrist. Everything chosen to minimize distraction — his clothes are infrastructure, not expression.
